none: PAS NLM-B737B2: Roman Cioin: Radiate fraction of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate fraction of Tetricus II (272-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]ETRIC[--]. Reverse description: Female figure advancing left, possibly Spes. Reverse inscription: CR suggests possibly [--]VGG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 3 nos 11292-11294..
